title: plantago subulata subsp. humilis
intro: Plantago subulata subsp. humilis, commonly known as a low-growing, spreading form of the Plantago subulata plant, is a type of flowering plant in the Plantaginaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, and it has been traditionally used to support respiratory health and reduce inflammation. The health benefits of Plantago subulata subsp. humilis are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, expectorant, and vulnerary properties, which may help soothe coughs, wounds, and digestive issues. The plant's bioactive constituents, such as mucilage, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, contribute to its medicinal effects, although further research is needed to fully understand its potential benefits and applications.
